item.title: Tell HN: I never mean to flag anything
item.summary: Sorry if I ever flagged your posts! I just looked at my flagged posts after accidentally clicking "flag". You view them at https://news.ycombinator.com/flagged?id=rgbrgb. I have multiple pages of flags and I've literally never hit that button on purpose. A confirmation dialogue would go a long way.
